P.reason: The precondition hard-codes the 1% example (10,000 deposited, 9,900 received) as a required condition, whereas the report presents it as an illustrative example of the general FoT deduction.

I.reason: The safety intent that credited balance should not exceed tokens actually received matches the report's stated issue that _updateBalance credits full amount without measuring received tokens.

V.reason: The effect that recorded balances exceed actual holdings creating phantom balances matches the report's Balance Inflation impact.

main_fidelity_issue: The precondition narrows the general fee-on-transfer scenario to the specific 1% example (10,000 deposited, 9,900 received) as a required condition, rather than treating it as illustrative.
